_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in the coil with no long-unwind or ETF-rebound breaker; base rate favors HOLD until F&G/momentum clears the stated bands.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD to Complacency; narrative only implies mild accumulation via outflows, no phase/direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-55 and 30d BTC change stays inside roughly -8% to +5% with ETF flows still subdued
next_move.invalidated_if: 30d momentum under about -8% with funding flipping negative, or ETF-flow rebound lifting F&G through 60
